title: Basic.
text: Basic.. I had hopes for this little wooden napkin holder by Woho. It is “U” shaped and stained a pretty brown. The wood is nothing special except it shows some grain/striations in the wood. It is very rugged looking. Does what it is supposed to do, just nothing extraordinary. Wish it had been a little larger.
